scope: Shared cached image-goal extension on the independent LeRobot camera/data. Expert only constructs evaluation goals,never supplies training/online optimal actions. Goal uses first native success within500 steps,or final frame on failure; all cases/failures retained. Not the published JEPA-WMs100-step goal protocol or standard task-ID-conditionedMT50. Expert failure is not proof of task impossibility; report goal-valid and all-case rates separately.
